name: Multiple Importance Sampling for Boundary Segments
definition: A method combining Multiple Importance Sampling (MIS) with primary-sample-space guiding to handle both light-source sampling and direct direction sampling for the boundary segment direction w_B, addressing occlusion issues in complex lighting.
summary: Multiple Importance Sampling for Boundary Segments estimates boundary contributions in differentiable volume rendering by combining light-source and direct direction sampling via separate K-d trees, avoiding the cost of full 5D guiding.
